title: Smoky Black-Eyed Pea Salad
description: A flavorful and nutritious salad featuring smoky black-eyed peas, crispy bacon, and a tangy vinaigrette.
instructions: Cook the black-eyed peas according to package instructions.
Crisp the bacon in a pan over medium heat.
Chop the bacon into small pieces.
Dice the red onion and chop the salad into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked black-eyed peas, chopped bacon, diced onion, and chopped salad.
In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar and olive oil.
Pour the vinaigrette over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
